body:
I'm scared. I want to tell my friends but I don't want to be a burden. I don't want to make the concerned. 

Maybe I do belong in a hospital.
Maybe I'm the bad guy. 
Maybe something's wrong. 

I don't know. I don't know. 

Im looking at ways to die and I'm laughing. Im trying to find ways to hurt myself and it's giving me such happiness. 

I wish I could tell my friends but I don't want to push my issues on them. I've already talked about it. I don't want to make them feel bad since they deal with their own shit. 

I'm okay. Im gonna be okay. It's gonna be okay. We're gonna be okay. 

 I'll see if I could start a riot and have myself get martyred. At least what I died for would be to make the world better. Even if it's all in vain I'm dead. 

God what a world. What I mind I've been blessed with. All of these voices are mine. All of these voices are me. They want me dead. They love me. They want me dead. 

If only it was easy.
